ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute with no refund: the only off-route segment (F3) was covered by the rider's own consent to Lavender Street, leaving 4.10 − 3.73 = 0.37 km within the 1 km tolerance; no driver violation is recorded (traffic reason on record, F11) and no account flag applies.
ruling.reasoning:
The GPS record settles the arithmetic: 18.0 km driven against a 13.9 km optimal route, +4.1 km, with one off-route segment 14:29–14:38 adding 3.73 km [F1][F3][RD-1]. That exceeds the 1 km tolerance, so RD-2 governs the amount [F4][RD-2].

Notice and consent for that segment are settled by the chat, and the record is complete and timestamped [F9]. At 14:26 the driver asked "ok if I go round via Lavender Street?" [F7] and the rider answered at 14:26 "可以，走 Lavender Street 吧" [F8] — a yes to a road the driver named, sent before the segment began at 14:29 [F3], so it is consent in time and in the right channel [RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement adds nothing independent [F10]; it is not relied on.

Scope: the words name a specific road, Lavender Street, and LAVENDER STREET is among the roads this segment drove [F3][F8]. Under RD-5 that ties the agreement to the segment, and the roads before and after Lavender Street are part of going via Lavender Street [RD-5]. Nothing in the record places the segment on an errand of the driver's own or on a road the rider ruled out, so the exemption covers the whole segment [F3][RD-5].

The traffic reason does not exempt any km: Central Expressway ran at speed band 2 (10–19 km/h) from 14:12–14:38, before and through the segment [F11], and the trace treats that as a traffic reason with no driver violation recorded [RD-4]. Under RD-2 the amount turns entirely on whether the rider agreed or asked for the route, which she did [RD-2][RD-5].

Amount: exempt km from the agreed segment = 3.73 km [F3]; deviation 4.10 km − 3.73 km exempt = 0.37 km remaining, which is under the 1 km tolerance, so no refund is due [F4][RD-1]. Had the segment counted, the figure would be (4.10 km − 0 km exempt) × $1.4102/km = $5.78 [F4][RD-2], but it does not.

No surge element: multiplier 1.0× [F5], and base $3.90, time $6.39 and platform $1.47 are not in issue [F6]. No repeat-deviation flag applies: 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F17][RD-6]. The rider's fraud flag [F16] never decides a case; it only bears on how the ruling may execute.

No excluded road and no driver-chosen off-route place appears in the record, so the roads before and after Lavender Street are part of going via Lavender Street.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider argues the consent reaches one road only and not the rest of the 6.23 km [F3]. RD-5's road-name check ties the consent to the segment once the named road is driven, and the extra km are exempt in full — the roads before and after Lavender Street are the way to it [F3][F8][RD-5].

Claiming the full $5.78 as the refundable measure ignores RD-2's exemption of the km covered by the rider's own agreement: 3.73 km of the 4.10 km billed are exempt, leaving 0.37 km, under the 1 km tolerance [F3][F4][RD-1][RD-2][RD-5].
Correct that a traffic reason never exempts a segment — but it is the rider's own agreement, not the CTE congestion, that exempts the segment here [F7][F8][F11][RD-2][RD-5].
The DISP-2026-0089 precedent cited is an uninformed reroute; here the rider was told at 14:26 and agreed in her own words before the 14:29 segment, so no refund follows [F7][F8][F3][RD-5].

The driver's residual of 0.52 is arithmetically his own concession, but it is wrong: it refunds 0.37 km, whereas 4.10 km − 3.73 km exempt = 0.37 km remains and is under the 1 km tolerance, so nothing is refundable [F3][F4][RD-1][RD-2].

Correct that no surge differential arises at 1.0× [F5], but the fare facts do not limit the outcome — the whole case turns on RD-5 scope, and with the segment exempt no partial refund is due at all [F3][F4][RD-2][RD-5].

The rider's complaint confirms she agreed to the change, and that agreement is what exempts the segment; it is not read as leaving a refundable residue, because the km beyond Lavender Street are part of going via Lavender Street [F3][F8][RD-5].
